messages:
Jordan Lee: heads-up — Meridian's dedicated pool (meridian-prod-2) is seeing p95 spikes after we turned on the longer-context variant. Customer is on 8xA100s. They asked for a token budget bump but I want eng-runtime to validate first. 👀
Maria Chen: can you paste a short repro & the SLO they're targeting? are these long-running completions or many short ones?
Jordan Lee: mix: ~80% short (<64t) chat completions, 20% long generation bursts (8k–16k). Spikes happen during the long tails. Their SLO is 300ms p95 per request for the short flows; long bursts can be higher but system-wide latency suffers.
Ravi Kumar (ops): pulled a flame/profile during a spike — KV cache churn is high for that tenant, leading to repeated KV repop and kernel fallback. Quick snippet from profilebot: 
```
perfbot: tenant=meridian-prod-2
  step=gen: kernel_selected=fast_gemm_fp16
  fallback_count=3 -> generic_kernel
  throughput: 112 tok/s -> 34 tok/s after fallback
  kv_cache_miss_rate=18%
```
Sam Ortiz: hmm that fallback drop looks bad. Two levers: 1) bias batching to prefer smaller, lower-latency batches while long bursts drain a token budget, 2) raise per-tenant token budget and tighten queue caps so one long request doesn't starve short jobs.
Maria Chen: agree. For dedicated tenants we usually set token_budget_target and queue.max_tokens_per_batch. What numbers does Meridian want? Jordan?
Jordan Lee: Meridian asked for a conservative bump so their chat UI doesn't feel laggy. Proposed: token_budget_target=3000 tokens / 5s window (i.e., 600 tps sustained) and queue.max_tokens_per_batch=8192 to allow long-context but cap batch size growth. Also reduce continuous_batching.max_wait_ms from 40 -> 20 for their queue to prioritize small requests.
Ravi Kumar (ops): that config is reasonable. Two concerns: 1) KV miss rate — raising batch cap might increase KV pressure if many long requests land together. 2) Kernel selector still falls back; we should force kernel hints for the long-model variant if safe. Can perfbot enumerate why selection failed?
perfbot: kernel selector log (last canary): 
```
model=redwood-16k-large
seq_len=12000
gpu_mem_pressure=0.87
kernels_tried=[fast_gemm_fp16, amx_opt]
reason_for_fallback=unsupported_tile_size_for_amx_opt (runtime only)

suggested_action: set kernel_hint=fast_gemm_fp16 for this model on pool meridian-prod-2 and schedule rolling restart of worker tasks.
```
Sam Ortiz: action plan I'd propose: 1) Apply tenant config patch (token_budget_target=3000/5s, max_tokens_per_batch=8192, max_wait_ms=20) as a canary on 2 of 8 nodes in the pool. 2) Apply kernel_hint override for redwood-16k-large pinned to fast_gemm_fp16 on those same nodes. 3) Monitor p95/p99 for 30m, and watch kv_cache_miss_rate and kernel fallback_count. 4) If stable, roll to rest of pool.
Jordan Lee: can you put required CLI/patch here so I can share with Meridian support?
Ravi Kumar (ops): sure, sample patch CLI below — will run in canary mode first:
```bash
# tenant config patch
rconfig patch-tenant --tenant meridian --env prod \
  --set continuous_batching.token_budget_target=3000 \
  --set continuous_batching.token_budget_window_s=5 \
  --set queue.max_tokens_per_batch=8192 \
  --set continuous_batching.max_wait_ms=20 \
  --canary-nodes=meridian-prod-2-node-[1,2]

# kernel hint override
rconfig patch-node --node meridian-prod-2-node-1 \
  --set kernel_hints.redwood-16k-large=fast_gemm_fp16 \
  --canary
```
Maria Chen: perfect. Ravi — please also add a beats job to snapshot kv_cache_miss_rate, fallback_count, and tail latency every 30s for the canary window and post prod alerts if p95 > 600ms for short requests.
Ravi Kumar (ops): will do. Scheduling canary now, ETA 10m. I'll post results in this thread.
Jordan Lee: thanks — cc @Meridian support. I'll tell them we expect a 30m canary and we'll only roll if metrics look good. :+1:
perfbot: canary started on nodes meridian-prod-2-node-1,2. monitoring hooks: kv_cache_miss_rate, fallback_count, p50/p95/p99.
Maria Chen: reminder — open a small regression test run with the same traffic mix against the canary nodes to validate kernel hint doesn't regress gen quality/throughput. Sam, can you take that?
Sam Ortiz: on it, will run a 20m traffic replay with 80/20 short/long mix and post the result.
Ravi Kumar (ops): canary metrics after 30m back here in ~40m.
Jordan Lee: appreciate it team. Filing ticket: INC-2026 for tracking.
Maria Chen: thanks — will sync after canary.
